property_summary: For any input, after a call to play() completes (or reverts), the contract's ether balance always equals c.pot() — the reference credits the pot with every ticket payment (10 wei in, pot 10), while the mutant never credits it, so after a losing draw balance==10 but pot==0, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete the statement 'pot += msg.value;' so the pot is never credited with the ticket payment.
